//: Per-field guidance for the behavioral health self-report battery. Static form-level wording only.

client.first_name.question: Before we begin the assessments, what is your first name?
client.first_name.help: This identifies whose self-report assessment summary is being completed.

client.last_name.question: What is your last name?
client.last_name.help: This helps match the assessment summary to the correct client record.

client.dob.question: What is your date of birth?
client.dob.help: The date of birth helps the EMR match this self-report assessment to the correct client.

selected.dsm5_level1.question: Do you want to include the broad DSM-5-TR Level 1 symptom screen?
selected.dsm5_level1.help: This is a broad self-report screen across mood, anxiety, sleep, memory, substance use, and related symptom areas.

selected.phq9.question: Do you want to include the PHQ-9 depression screen?
selected.phq9.help: PHQ-9 is a short self-report screen about depression symptoms over the last two weeks.

selected.gad7.question: Do you want to include the GAD-7 anxiety screen?
selected.gad7.help: GAD-7 asks about common anxiety symptoms over the last two weeks.

selected.cssrs.question: Do you want to include the C-SSRS self-report suicide safety screener?
selected.cssrs.help: This asks direct safety questions about thoughts of death, suicide, planning, intent, or past behavior.

selected.auditc.question: Do you want to include the AUDIT-C alcohol screen?
selected.auditc.help: AUDIT-C is a brief self-report alcohol screen about drinking frequency and amount.

selected.taps.question: Do you want to include the TAPS tobacco, alcohol, prescription medication, and substance-use screen?
selected.taps.help: TAPS screens for tobacco, alcohol, prescription medication misuse, and other substance use.

selected.dast10.question: Do you want to include the DAST-10 drug-use screen?
selected.dast10.help: DAST-10 asks yes/no questions about drug-use related problems.

selected.pcl5.question: Do you want to include the PCL-5 PTSD symptom screen?
selected.pcl5.help: PCL-5 asks about PTSD-related symptoms connected to a stressful or traumatic experience.

selected.mdq.question: Do you want to include the Mood Disorder Questionnaire?
selected.mdq.help: The MDQ screens for patterns of unusually elevated or irritable mood, increased energy, and related problems.

selected.whodas12.question: Do you want to include the WHODAS 2.0 functioning screen?
selected.whodas12.help: WHODAS asks how much difficulty the client has had with daily functioning over the last 30 days.

selected.dla20.question: Do you want to include the DLA-20 self-report functioning screen?
selected.dla20.help: This self-report functioning screen asks about practical daily living areas such as housing, safety, self-care, relationships, and routines.

phq9.q9.help: This asks about thoughts of death or self-harm. Answer the closest frequency. The result is flagged for safety review if any level is endorsed.

dsm5.q11.help: This asks whether thoughts of hurting yourself have bothered you recently. Answer the closest amount. The result is flagged for safety review if any level is endorsed.

cssrs.wish_dead.help: This is a direct safety question. A yes answer does not mean you did something wrong; it helps make sure the right support follows.

mdq.impairment.help: This asks how much the mood or energy changes affected life, relationships, work, school, or responsibilities.
